call_points.text: Full-year FY27 Unicommerce profitability is expected to remain in line with FY26 despite current investments.
Customer demand during the festive period has been strong with units growing 60% YoY in the first half of October.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Services > Retailing > E-Retail/ E-Commerce

operating_notes.text: Fashion listings increased by over 91% YoY to 95 lakh in H1 FY27, accounting for 68.4% of NMV.

timeline.summary: Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹151.19 Cr, net loss to shareholders ₹22.32 Cr.
AceVector reported H1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹285.5 Cr and an Adjusted EBITDA loss of ₹26.9 Cr.
Audio link of conference call for Q1, Q2 and H1 FY27 made available on company website on 27 Oct 2026.
